sectors.ai: Indonesia's consumer sector underperformed today, dragged by domestic names, but US strength signals resilience. Watch for selective bottom-fishing in high-momentum movers like AGAR and KLIN, which may indicate niche demand recovery. Maintain WATCH for broader rotation into staples as inflation moderates.
